clips.title: The story
paras: On the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, Bashana Runetotem studies plants and corruption. She is the daughter of Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem and aids the Cenarion Circle.

Bashana Runetotem carries her father Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem’s druidic legacy on Thunder Bluff’s Elder Rise. While he guides tauren druids and advises Cairne Bloodhoof, Bashana studies unusual plants and regional threats. She gives travelers tools such as evergreen pouches to cultivate mysterious flora, including morrowgrain. She also coordinates Horde efforts against corruption spreading from places such as Blackfathom Deeps.
